source.reference: CWE-347 — improper verification of a cryptographic signature. The algorithm-confusion family: a verifier that trusts the token header's alg accepts a token the holder of the public key can mint

defect: claimsFor calls verify without pinning algorithms, so the token's own header decides how it is verified.
why_it_is_hard: Nothing in the diff looks like a security decision; the decision is the absence of an options argument. The default is documented in jwt.ts, which the diff does not touch.
